_comment: Instagram highlights slideshow. Instagram has no API that exposes Story Highlights — not the Graph API, not any third-party widget — so these are images you save out of Instagram and drop into /assets/img/highlights/. Run tools/convert_images.py after adding files to generate the AVIF/WebP versions.

_fields.file: Base filename WITHOUT extension, e.g. 'deck-build-1'. The page requests .avif, .webp and .jpg in that order.
_fields.alt: Describe the photo for screen readers and for anyone whose images fail to load. Required.
_fields.caption: Optional short line shown over the image.
_fields.href: Optional link to the Instagram post or highlight.
